The '''Xo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Xo]].
